name: Dalaran Crater
shortDescription: Dalaran Crater, a named setting in the Karazhan research story.
body: The associated original environment art preserves these The abandoned crater-era city: a broad circular escarpment, broken pale stone, the incomplete violet protective dome and Lake Lordamere; not Northrend-era Dalaran. It remains an interpretive scene; no exact route, dungeon layout or surveyed coordinate is asserted.
